title: PTF Library
description: Open courses for the Personal Tutor Format: how large language models work, gravity from Pisa to Einstein.

packages.title: Gravity: from the leaning tower to curved spacetime
packages.summary: Why heavy and light things fall together, what air and ramps change, how one law holds apples and moons, and how Einstein replaced the pull with curved spacetime.
